acceptanceFramework.notes: N < 450 on locked OOS => INCONCLUSIVE regardless of observed P_win. No conversion to PASS/REJECT.

canonicalizationRule.gapPolicy: Detected gaps are quarantined intervals. No interpolation, no backfill inference, no retrospective fill.
canonicalizationRule.quarantineThresholdText: >30 minutes of missing expected candles => quarantine the interval. Window clock keeps running; quarantine does NOT authorize selective extension to chase N.
canonicalizationRule.statusFilter: CLOSED only. FORMING snapshots are contamination and MUST be discarded before any statistic.

collectionWindow.clockPolicy: 30 consecutive calendar days from effective recorder start. Clock runs continuously through quarantines; no selective extension to chase N.
collectionWindow.effectiveStartRule: Effective start = timestamp of first canonical CLOSED candle collected AFTER the venue discovery receipt (item 8) is saved in-repo. Pre-receipt stream data does NOT count as IS.
collectionWindow.selectiveExclusion: FORBIDDEN. No window may be excluded, weighted, or disabled based on any observed metric (Invariant 9).

deploymentCeiling.promotionRule: Any promotion beyond Practice requires new SPEC + Level-2 venue fidelity audit + Tri-Proof CRO PASS + 4-way quorum.

discoveryPrecondition.gate: IS collection MUST NOT start counting until the discovery receipt exists in-repo with timestamp BEFORE the first counted IS candle. Payout is NEVER a frozen constant; if r varies intraday, the frozen object is the capture/snapshot rule.
